fact: CADECO and the Comite de suivi de la paie (CSP) validated final technical and organisational adjustments for deploying proximity pay of state agents and civil servants in rural DRC, with first operations to cover several rural zones.

The Ministry of Public Service says civil servants' pay is delivered through bank accounts, ten years after payroll bancarisation was launched, with gaps remaining such as no bank branches in some areas and slow account opening.
